gaps.term: normalized Fourier transform as a contraction
gaps.quote: A normalized Fourier transform is a contraction, since each output averages inputs multiplied by complex numbers of modulus one.
gaps.note: Calling each output an average needs the normalization factor (1/q), which this page never states. With the 1/sqrt(q) normalization the input (1,...,1) maps to (sqrt(q),0,...,0), which has norm sqrt(q), so the contraction claim depends on a definition the reader cannot see here.
